text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Out on an outing with Smart Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. We still have plenty of 
time before we need to head back..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to do together. 
Will you hear out Falco's request?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To put it bluntly! I want to go location 
scouting!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the music video required 
of a top umadol, beyond just the shooting 
and editing methods—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Locations that bring out Falco's charm 
even more are super important too, so...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna study up now so I can have them 
shoot a super cute PV for me in the 
future!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay~! That's the spirit♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know! Since we're here, I wanna 
hear what Trainer-san thinks☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Where do you think is a spot that fits 
the cute image of Falco?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: An aquarium...! The ultimate cute spot!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-Throbbing☆Aquarium"... Yep! That 
title is totally perfect♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight☆ Now that that's settled, 
let's hurry and go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I headed to the aquarium with Smart 
Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Waaah~! So many pretty and cute little 
fishies☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer-san! This little guy's 
fins look just like a frilly skirt!
choice_data_list: It looks like an Umadol outfit.

It looks like an Umadol outfit, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha! Falco feels the exact same way!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You think just like Falco now, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we're only getting started, you 
know? Falco will keep standing center 
stage—”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely going to make my dream of 
becoming a cute top Umadol come true☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm counting on you♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, I need to do some proper 
scouting—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"……Be careful around the aquariums that 
don't allow photography, okay! I'm 
counting on you for the reference photos, 
Trainer!☆"
choice_data_list:
You never miss a chance to be shrewd, do 
you...

You're pretty shrewd about that, aren't 
you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward... we scouted locations at the 
aquarium until she was satisfied, and then 
headed back together.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"A movie theater...! You must be expecting 
great things from me across the board!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-Throbbing☆Theater Debut"... Yep! 
That title is totally perfect♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight☆ Now that that's settled, 
let's hurry and go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I headed to the movie theater with Smart 
Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Alrighty then! First, I gotta check 
what movies are currently playing!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Families, groups of friends, couples... 
The atmosphere of a theater changes with 
its audience, you know? ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! The key to scouting locations 
lies in one's power of observation, after 
all—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... "Idol☆Glitter Saga"! Oh right, it's 
already in theaters...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A story of idol sisters chosen by the 
starlight, striving for the ultimate Super 
Stage...!!
choice_data_list:
…Want to watch it together while we're at 
it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? A-Are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "...I'm so happy! Thank you, Trainer-san☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Once we finish scouting the location 
properly, let's have tons of fun together, 
okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward... thoroughly enjoying the 
location scouting and the movie, I headed 
home together with a deeply satisfied her.
